info.name: Inventory & Order Management API (Render)
info.description:
Complete, chained test collection for the deployed Inventory & Order Management API.

SETUP: open the collection > Variables and set `adminPassword` (the ADMIN_PASSWORD configured on Render).
Then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (top to bottom, in order).

Each run creates its own dummy data (a STAFF user and products with unique SKUs based on `runId`),
so it never depends on, or modifies, existing products. Tokens and IDs are captured automatically.

Note: the Render free tier sleeps when idle; the first request (Health) may take up to ~1 minute.

item.name: 01 - Health
item.description: API liveness and database connectivity. Also starts a new test run (new runId).

exec: // Start a fresh run: unique suffix for emails, SKUs and names.

item.name: 02 - Auth
item.description: Registration and login. Public registration always creates a STAFF user.

exec: pm.test("adminPassword variable is set", () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminPassword"), "Set adminPassword in collection variables").to.not.be.empty);

item.name: Register with name (and role injection attempt)

request.description: Sending role ADMIN is ignored: public sign-ups are always STAFF.

item.name: 03 - Products (ADMIN)
item.description: ADMIN creates dummy products for this run and exercises CRUD, validation, pagination and search.

item.name: Create product C - USB Hub (low stock)

request.description: SKUs are case-insensitive (stored upper-case), so lower-case still conflicts.

exec: pm.test("name, sku, stock reported", () => pm.expect(body.error.details.map(d => d.field)).to.include.members(["name", "sku", "stock"]));

item.name: Search by run id (name or SKU) - 4 results
04 - Authorization (STAFF & no token)
item.description: STAFF may read products but not create, update or delete them. Missing/invalid tokens are rejected.

item.name: 05 - Orders (STAFF)
item.description: Transactional orders: totals, stock deduction, price snapshots, rollback on insufficient stock, validation.

item.name: Create order (2 x Laptop + 3 x Mouse)

exec: pm.test("Two items with product names and price snapshots", () => { pm.expect(body.data.items).to.have.length(2); body.data.items.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.productName).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(i.unitPrice).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/); }); });
pm.test("Order belongs to the STAFF user", () => pm.expect(body.data.user.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("staffEmail")));
pm.test("Newest first; contains this order", () => pm.expect(body.data.map(o => o.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderId"))));

item.name: Price snapshot survives a price change

request.description: ADMIN changes the laptop price; the existing order must keep 45999.50.

item.name: Order still shows original unit price

exec: pm.test("Laptop unit price is still 45999.50", () => pm.expect(body.data.items.find(i => i.productId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("productAId"))).unitPrice).to.eql("45999.50"));

pm.test("Details show requested vs available", () => { const d = body.error.details[0]; pm.expect(d.productId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("productCId"))); pm.expect(d.requested).to.eql(5); pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(2); });

request.description: Laptop has stock 10 (enough for 1); USB Hub has stock 2 (not enough for 5). Nothing may change.

item.name: Rollback check: USB Hub stock still 2

request.description: Products that appear in orders cannot be deleted (order history is preserved).

item.name: 06 - Reports
item.description: Low-stock report: products with stock strictly below the threshold.

exec: pm.test("Every product is below 10", () => body.data.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.below(10)));
